tagline: Nine months. Fifty-five receipts. One story.
features: Story Mode — 9 monthly chapters with persona stamps and moment chains
Threads Board — interactive SVG relationship graph with 43 edges across 9 type lanes
Life Map — SVG equirectangular projection with 8 geolocated places (Mumbai, Lonavala, Udaipur)
Patterns — 5 computed insight blocks (theme recurrence matrix, morning shift circadian, intent-to-action lags, spending ledger, inner voice arc)
Archive — real-time multi-facet search and filter across all 55 receipts with slips and table views
Receipt Drawer — global deep-link overlay via ?r=RXXX URL scheme with prev/next navigation
Keyboard Navigation — ? help modal + g+h/s/t/m/p/a/x shortcuts
